title: rollback-and-compatibility-matrix-for-private-upgrades
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Implement automated, testable rollback scenarios and a machine-readable compatibility matrix to support safe control plane upgrades in Private (VPC) deployments. This ticket covers Terraform/IaC patterns, preflight validations, canary cohort selection, health gating, and an automated rollback path that is exercised by CI and operator tooling. The deliverable should reduce manual intervention during upgrades, shorten mean time to recover for failed upgrades, and provide deterministic decisioning for rollback vs continue.

Background: We currently stage canaries using ad-hoc scripts and manual checks. Several post-mortems highlighted unclear version compatibility between control plane, node agents, and operator tooling leading to manual rollbacks and extended incidents. We need an automated, codified path that: (1) knows which component versions are compatible, (2) can run preflight checks against a target environment via Terraform dry-run and integration checks, (3) can perform an automated rollback that is safe and observable, and (4) surfaces exact root-cause signals to on-call and SRE.

Scope: private control-plane upgrades only (VPC/private deployments). Worker runtime upgrades are out-of-scope but compatibility matrix must indicate worker constraints. Terraform module updates for upgrade orchestration and a CI job that validates rollback paths must be included.
acceptance_criteria: A machine-readable compatibility matrix (YAML in repo) that maps control-plane versions to operator and agent versions and is consumed by the upgrade pipeline
A Terraform module (registry versioned) that can toggle 'upgrade-safe-mode' and create canary cohorts with labels/tags without changing customer workloads
Preflight job that runs terraform plan + dry-run integration tests and fails when compatibility matrix disallows target version
Automated rollback workflow: if health gates fail within 30 minutes of canary promotion, operator triggers rollback and publishes a rollback event to event-log and incident dashboard
End-to-end test in CI simulating a canary failure that verifies rollback executes and cluster returns to pre-upgrade state
Runbook updated with step-by-step rollback verification, post-rollback diagnostics, and ticket templates
Telemetry dashboards and alerts for the defined health gates (error rate, API latency, reconciliation failures) that show before/after traces for canary cohorts
tasks: Design compatibility matrix schema and add to infra/upgrade/compatibility.yaml
Implement preflight pipeline job (ci/upgrade-preflight) that validates terraform plan and runs smoke integration checks
Create operator endpoint to accept 'rollback-to-version' and 'snapshot-state' commands
Instrument health gates: API schema diff check, controlplane reconcile latency, per-pod restart rate, KV-store migration lag
Write CI integration test that introduces a regression and asserts rollback path succeeds
Update console incident dashboard and create Grafana panels for canary cohorts
Author runbook and playbook with exact query snippets and common failure patterns
notes: Compatibility matrix will live in repo at infra/upgrade/compatibility.yaml and will be consumed by both the operator and CI preflight jobs
We will adopt semantic version constraints with explicit supported ranges instead of implicit 'latest' pins
Rollback will prefer fast-path (image re-pinning + operator rollout) and fall back to database snapshot restore only if state migration is incompatible
Terraform plan checks should fail-fast: any diff that removes or mutates critical RBAC or secret keys requires manual approval
Coordination required with SRE for thresholds for 'health gate' (suggested initial thresholds in telemetry_requirements)

runbook_summary: If an upgrade triggers health gates: 1) operator should attempt automated rollback; 2) on-call verifies rollback event and checks rollback-success metric; 3) run diagnostics: compare preflight plan, check schema-diff tool, collect reconciliation traces; 4) if rollback fails, escalate to infra on-call and follow DB snapshot restore playbook.
